+@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_connections", [1, 2])

+    ) as pool:
+        for index in range(max_connections):
+            await pool.request("GET", f"https://host{index}.example.com/")
+        idle_connections = list(pool.connections)
+
+        async with pool.stream("GET", "https://new.example.com/") as response:
+            assert len(pool.connections) == max_connections
+            assert idle_connections[0].is_closed()
+            assert idle_connections[0] not in pool.connections
+            assert pool.connections[:-1] == idle_connections[1:]
+            await response.aread()
+            assert response.content == b"Hello, world!"
+
